checks: Future time in the ‘until’ clause is expressed with the simple present; singular ‘the quality manager’ uniquely selects ‘approves’. The noun and the other verb forms are ruled out. Translation preserves the negative hold, inspection report, and lot release; all rationales checked.

activeQuestion.prompt: We cannot release the batch until the quality manager ____ the inspection report.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 在品管經理____檢驗報告之前，我們不能放行這批貨。

options.whyZh: 此處缺少子句的動詞，名詞 approval 無法充當述語。
此處 until 時間子句以現在式表示未來，不用 will。
until 引導未來時間子句時使用現在式，manager 為單數。
主詞 the quality manager 是第三人稱單數，需加 s。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: until 引導未來時間子句時使用現在式，manager 為單數。
